design: All-nine unpatched/reference controls before inference; taskwise alternating arm order; same image/server/sampling, concurrency one.
data_identity_scope: Both arms use the same data-root paths. Selected snapshot bytes and task corpus are hashed; wheel/graph/embedding trees are not recursively hashed.

baseline.agent.yaml:
name: swe_baseline_agent
model: gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct
adapter: main_lora
instruction: !include prompts/system.md
tools:
  - run_command
  - read_file
  - edit_file
  - write_file
  - get_status
  - submit_patch
  - get_code_neighbors
  - search_similar_code
  - get_code_subgraph
  - agent_tool:
      config_path: sub_agents/code_analyzer.yaml
      skip_summarization: true
generate_content_config: !include configs/sampling.yaml
baseline.configs/sampling.yaml:
temperature: 0.2
top_p: 0.95
max_output_tokens: 16384
thinking_config:
  thinking_budget: 4096
  include_thoughts: true
baseline.eval_config.yaml:
# Optional participant evaluation configuration for Stage 1 inference.
# Controls per-task execution budgets and sandbox command timeouts.
# Global ceiling: 12 hours across all ~120 hidden tasks (sequential).
# Container setup is excluded from max_time_minutes (agent-loop only).
# Setting max_time_minutes conservatively to leave margin against the
# catastrophic failure mode of exceeding the global 12-hour cap.
evaluation:
  timeout_seconds: 90
  max_tool_calls: 40
  max_time_minutes: 4
  max_turns: 100
baseline.sub_agents/code_analyzer.yaml:
name: code_analyzer_agent
description: Analyzes repository source files and symbol graphs to locate root causes.
model: gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct
adapter: tool_lora
instruction: !include ../prompts/analyzer.md
tools:
  - read_file
  - search_similar_code
  - get_code_neighbors
  - get_code_subgraph
generate_content_config: !include ../configs/sampling.yaml

offline_network.scope: Local verifier compatibility for existing Requests TCP timeout fixtures; not scorer-network parity
